sample_unit: patient eye health questions with paired physician and ChatGPT responses

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of ChatGPT versus ophthalmologist responses to patient questions
links.effect: ChatGPT responses were harder to read: mean FKGL 12.7 (SD=1.9) vs 11.0 (SD=2.7) for ophthalmologists, p<0.001; both above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: Ophthalmologist responses were easier to understand, with a lower mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (Grade 11.0 [SD=2.7] vs Grade 12.7 [SD=1.9], p<0.001).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance (accuracy, readability, empathy, length) of GPT-4o compared to ophthalmologists on forum queries, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
